periods.story: Lives in a coastal town. Loves sketching the stars with her grandfather. Dreams of being an astronaut.
Grandfather gave her a camera. Joined astronomy club, wonders about leaving home.
Moved to the city, became a junior photographer instead of an astronaut; treasures grandfather's camera.
Established photographer; values time with loved ones more than awards, still admires the stars.
Starts weekend community photography workshops for learners unable to afford classes.
Walks at dawn, shares stories and teaches; brings out grandfather's camera on special occasions.
